_meta.note: Written for this project (Gujarati and English are the working languages). Not independently reviewed.

strings.legalSub: Everything currently stored in the database — Constitution, guides, offices and glossary.
strings.otherLanguageOnly: This item is not available in the selected language.
strings.cardLegalBody: Search everything available — by language and category.
strings.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection or try again shortly.
strings.aboutBody: NYAYMITRA 2.0 helps citizens with legal information in plain language, the right office to approach, and drafting a complaint. It is not a judge or a lawyer.
strings.heroBody: Describe your problem. We show relevant legal information, the right government office and the next steps — with sources. We do not decide cases.
strings.cardAssistantBody: Cyber fraud, land, free legal aid or a pending government application — sourced information.
strings.cardComplaintBody: Fill in the details, review the summary, save it and submit it yourself through the official channel.
strings.cardLibraryBody: Search articles with their original source and verification status.
strings.cardDepartmentsBody: Official portals, helplines and the date each contact was checked.
strings.askHint: Gujarati or English. At least 5 characters.
strings.askPlaceholder: e.g. Someone withdrew 25,000 rupees from my bank account. What should I do?
strings.micUnsupported: Speech recognition is not available in this browser — please type.
strings.reportThanks: Thank you — your report is queued for human review.
strings.degradedNote: The AI service was unavailable, so a rule-based, source-grounded answer was produced instead.
strings.complaintIntro: Fill in the details below. The summary is built only from your own words, and nothing is saved until you review and confirm it.
strings.consent: I agree that this information may be stored on this server.
strings.confirmLabel: I have reviewed the summary and details above and confirm they are correct.
strings.tokenWarning: This token is shown once. Save it — without it the complaint cannot be opened again.
strings.librarySearch: Search an article number or a word
strings.noResultsHint: Try a different word, or call free legal aid on 15100.
strings.textNotLoaded: The authoritative text of this article is not loaded yet — only a human-written explanation is available.
strings.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.corpusWarning: Note: the authoritative article text is not loaded yet (0 articles). Only human-written explanations are shown.
strings.footerLine: AI-powered inclusive justice access and navigation.
strings.offlineBanner: No AI provider is configured — answers are rule-based and source-grounded.
strings.contentFallback: This content is not yet available in this language. It is shown in English.
strings.notAdvice: This is information, not legal advice.
strings.mtNotice: The interface text in this language was machine-translated and has not been reviewed by a native speaker. Legal content is NOT translated.
strings.partialNotice: Only part of the interface is available in this language; the rest is shown in English.
strings.langMatrixNote: Statuses are computed from what is actually stored. No Constitution text has been machine-translated.
strings.answerFallback: Answers are not yet available in this language, so this answer is in English or Gujarati. Nothing was machine-translated.
strings.textUnavailableIn: No text of this article is stored in this language.
strings.localeLoadFailed: The language file could not be loaded. Showing English.
